review_text:
tbh  its one of the games with the best combat feel ive ever played  especially when slayer came out the characters skills and sword were so satisfying that i couldve turned all my alts into slayers  but after a certain point  the game became unplayable because of gatekeeping  i quit about two years ago  but i wanted to come back and take a look 

but what i saw was the same thing again  the game was full of bots  when i last quit  it was pay to win  but now it has basically become pay to play  you literally cant move without spending money  and youre still forced to do your dailies with every character like some kind of slave  i dont understand how a company can ignore its players this much  even putting that aside  why are the bosses still so punishing  with this much gatekeeping and such a solid foundation for a great game  why not just make the game actually playable 

i mean  you cant even find a group for the bosses you need to fight every week to upgrade certain items  sometimes spending hours  days  or even weeks trying  some people just quit in the later stages because they dont want to bother  the old raid is meaningless  the gameplay feels pointless  the sense of progression drops so much after a certain gear score that i cant even find a single reason to keep playing this game 

honestly  its one of the rare games with really great level and combat design in my eyes  but i think it will shut down eventually like new world  so id say dont bother at all  especially expecting anything reasonable from these developers is more pointless than just sitting at home and waiting for your gpu to evolve itself

but this is not a true mh game  it feels like final fantasy  painted in mh colours  i don t want to disable items  i want to throw them out of the inventory  the story is incredibly annoying  we lost the mh language and the palico can shut up for all i care 
and the worst of it is the gogamizos fight  it s an easy battle  but the dps check is completely unnecessary  yes  we had dps checks in all games  yes its an established thing in the mh games  but it was always something special  in mh4u  you could at least scale the walls during the ultimate attack  you got cannons and railways and it felt like something was at stake 

and worst of all  this game runs badly  if you want an mh game to play  go play world

review_text:
i ve been playing warframe since gauss update  which is around 2019 or so  awesome fast paced looter shooter game 

i don t usually play third person shooter games with photo realistic design like these  but this one is an exception  the warframe designs which are like bio mechas are amazing  the gameplay is really fun  and it s not just about the guns  it also have melees and warframes abilities  which combines into unique builds  you can also change your warframes functionalities like strength  durations and range with mods and such  the cinematic stories are phenomenal and i still praise them till this day  the game also has a lot of game modes  which we will also come to this later  the game also has amazingly friendly comunity as well  this game is free to play while having aaa game level of designs  and you can grind premium currency ingame pretty easily 

however the game is quite grindy  which is the least worst thing on the list 
you want to play with new stuffs now  but you have to wait 3 days for it to finish crafting  which kills off the hype 
every content updates brings you new game modes  which is another content island that has barely anything to do with the rest of the game  with materials that once you have everything you can craft with that materials will  with no doubt  never want to have anything to do with that game mode ever again  although a lot of content updates adds a lot of refreshing new game modes and well  contents  they all feel so different that it feels like another game entirely  every time 
the game also lacks a form of  endgame content   by that i don t mean sitting in survival for 2 hours killing level 9999 foot soldiers  by that i mean actual hard bosses  assassinate missions are a joke  the bosses are forgettable  save for eidolons  orbs and ropalolyst  which are not available for majority of the player unless they grind really hard to unlock them  not to mention actually be able to beat them  railjacks are fun for the first hour or so  but it s also another content island which you don t want to have anything to do with  asides from those  liches and sisters hunts are actually quite fun  challenging and memorable as a boss  and does give some nice uses or raijacks as their dramatic final confrontation  the new orowyrm in duviri paradox is also quite something too  but wayy too easy 
i stopped playing warframe around the new war  but it s still fun enough to keep me coming back to the game occasionally because of the fun gameplay  the mechanics deep under it keeps pushing me away  and every updates with new game modes keep getting me dumbfounded of what is going on and what to do every time i return 

tldr  very fun game with fun gameplay  but once you look deeper  you will see a mess behind the mechanics

review_text:
i will leave you my few cents regarding lostark  as someone with over 9k hours in the game for the past 3 years  think i can pretty much tell you the reason why you should and shouldn t play this game at all 

so for the should 

are you unemployed or rich  then definitely this might be the game for you  as it currently stands for a ready to raid player  you will be needing either a lot of time to catch up  or spend more than 5k usd on rmt to have your basic stuff ready for it 
do you enjoy combat with great feel design  then again this game is definitely for you  lostark biggest strength lies on it s combat feel 

now for the shouldn t 
if you are someone who is not prepared to be put through long playing time because either there is someone who is messing up a lot with late raids  then yeah expect to lose a lot of time in pulls
if you are someone who gets frustated because the class you picked up is doing poorly  then again you are out of luck  smilegate the developer  has been pretty bad at balancing older classes vs newly released ones
are you familiar with wow fomo systems  then be prepared that every new raid might introduce a new gold sink and a new progression system
are you someone who enjoys having to get your feedback ignored  then be prepared  while amazon does a good job at compiling a lot of the feedback  the sad reality is that it gets ignored by smilegate 
are you someone who wants to min max  well that s too bad because smilegate doesn t like it that you can min max your build or char  there is always a need to keep you running on the wheel
you like raiding a lot  well good news  currently you can do up to 18 raids a week between 6 characters
oh also i forgot  unless you are putting some     into the game  then you must be mindful on your investment into your characters too  hence those 18 raids a week done might be done for you to funnel a character into a hard raid status raid ready while the rest rots in the bottom 

while lostark has creative raid and combat designs  it is constantly constrained and weighted down by many of the system designs that smilegate wants to push forward  there is no denying in the potential that the game could have  is still there  locked behind an incompetent developer that listens to whales first rather than the casual player
yes there are still express events that will let you raise 1 character to a playable status but this won t be enough for you to feel at an okay pace to play the game  my honest opinion is that really there are better things to do  learn a language  workout more  or other useful things  lostark is not a game you want to currently play unless you can ignore all the shouldn t and can be okay with the should to play it 

so yeah that s it folks  if you play and don t want to stress  make 6 valkyries and go full support or 6 bards too  then you have boobs and not so rough time 

so yeah imma go keep playing more wh40k rogue trader
cheers

review_text:
it s already been said that elden ring is one of the best games of all time  i can t argue that the visuals of the game are some of the best ever  every region looks like a painting come to life  the world is dreadful and sometimes horrific  but there are spots of wonder and pure fantasy 
the gameplay loop is quite addictive  after creating your character and opting in or out of the tutorial  the game throws you in the deep end to explore the world but always nudging you where to go to further the main quest  there s plenty of loot to find and challenging bosses to fight 

elden ring is not without it s faults  some inputs can feel delayed  and there is pop in and other very minimal graphical nitpicks i have  but my complaints are very minor  overall  this game is peak
